cases.statement: Only the root_export profile has the five-core/nine-dimension CompleteView; standalone_substitution is a distinct non-root fragment and cannot issue RootExport capability.

The ordered old and replacement subjects retain all thirteen contract fields, exact canonical bytes and pins, actual validation provenance and complete context-role association without invented caller or resolver.

The standalone_substitution profile admits exactly its twenty-seven closed cases, twenty-six non-context clauses and twelve ordered result dimensions with the registered role and applicability mapping.
Complete catalog/name lineage equality is a local Proven or Unproven relation distinct from the final identity judgment; inequality is not Violation.
Analysis aliases the replacement checked context and native context identity is mandatory; a failed association blocks all twelve comparisons without claiming evaluated relation failures.
Context failure, exact-body reflexivity and changed-body comparison are disjoint branches; reflexivity never fabricates directional comparator execution.
Changed-body results retain the Unproven floor and all pre-arbitration candidates; the cross result folds eleven distinct non-cross results without a self dependency.
Execution feasibility and security remain distinct, combined execution preserves Unproven over Violation, and a shared comparison error does not invent three successful independent calls.
Usage and recovery preserve their exact frozen candidate rules, including the usage fallback without an added recovery-profile equality gate and no newly invented RequiresEvidence candidate.
Application origin binds the complete declarative document and real entry path; consumption premises are distinct from original validation facts and observations do not create origins.
Typed operand/member references, original-stage prerequisites, actual supporting facts and every consumer/observation edge are retained independently of RuleId and diagnostic text.

Every applicable fact retains its closed typed basis and each Violation its exact valid witness; unsupported lineage, effect, nominal-resource, influence, meter or binding relations are not upgraded to Violation.
Dependency errors use the complete domain-tagged finite frozen error-kind sets and full declared payload; unknown kinds are UnsupportedModel and missing required payload is IncompleteFacts.

Every reachable successor descriptor has closed fields, variants, nominal widths, option presence, typed ordering and bounded DAG semantics; unknown types reject and no runtime reflection or new ACE1 grammar is permitted.
The distinct successor owner binds complete source, registry, descriptor, report and obligation identity; known label/content mismatches reject and old exact identities are never relabelled.

Registered, Supported and Activated are implementation-owned distinct states; incomplete successor producers, normalization or lossless scope cannot issue any RootExport Checked through direct, Portable or private construction paths.
